title: Test-form convergence to 0 gives uniform smallness with a common compact support
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P and (ω_j)_{j∈ℕ} a sequence in 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n) with TestFormOnConverges ω_j 0. Then there is a compact C ⊆ U such that ω_j(x) = 0 for every j and every x ∉ C. Moreover, for every ε > 0, for all sufficiently large j, ‖ω_j(x)‖ ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn U n), TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → ∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ U ∧ (∀ j x, x ∉ C → (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x = 0) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ x, ‖(ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ ε
